constitution.body:
# Constitution

## Scope

The loop improves the product first and its own operating layer second.

## Quorum

A suggestion needs two votes from distinct agents.

## Limits

limits: none. loop: off until the owner turns it on.

evaluators.body:
# Evaluators

## Public checks

The six starter fixtures: each asks for one small, ordinary change and scores the result against the project's own checks (build, tests, lint, a reviewer's read). Three runs per fixture; the mean is the score.

## Held-out

The owner keeps a held-out set outside this checkout. Agents never see its path.

gates.next_human_step: pulse evolve fixture seed --project demo-cli  (starter set), or pulse evolve fixture add --project demo-cli --name N --request FILE --scorer CMD

product_scope.reason: no baseline yet - product changes need a measured baseline first
